original_ai_output.title_zh: 卡杜纳州社区遭袭，据称两人死亡、20人被绑架
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据称疑似恐怖分子袭击了尼日利亚卡杜纳州卡奇亚地方政府区的阿夸多社区，造成两人死亡、20人被绑架。警方尚未证实此次袭击，据报袭击发生在周三中午前后。当地协会对库图尔米社区反复发生的杀戮和绑架表示担忧，并提到居民仍在应对复活节周日阿里科社区袭击的后续影响。

location.site: 卡奇亚地方政府区阿夸多社区
location.raw_text: Akwando community in Kachia Local Government Area of Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 据称疑似恐怖分子袭击卡杜纳州阿夸多社区，造成两人死亡、20人被绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Two people were reportedly killed and 20 others allegedly abducted after suspected terrorists attacked Akwando community in Kachia Local Government Area of Kaduna State on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: 警方尚未证实此次袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack, which the police have yet to confirm, reportedly occurred around noon.

key_facts.fact: 当地协会称库图尔米社区反复发生杀戮和绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The association expressed concern over recurring killings and abductions in Kuturmi communities

key_facts.fact: 此次事件发生在复活节周日阿里科社区袭击之后
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the latest incident happened while residents were still struggling with the aftermath of an Easter Sunday attack on Ariko community

uncertainties: 伤亡与绑架人数尚未获警方证实
袭击者身份仅为疑似恐怖分子
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
